title: NO LIMITS | Pearls of Wisdom from Devon Larratt
summary: Pearls of Wisdom episode on arm wrestler Devon Larratt, described as brave, crafty and deranged. NH draws lessons from his loss to Levan Saginashvili, his methodical training, and his daily contemplation of mortality, framing 'no limits' as refusing to let fear of defeat restrain you.
claims: Spotlighting great men risks creating fanboys; the worst thing you can do is try to become someone else, so use role models as momentum to build yourself
NH learns something from nearly every Devon Larratt video, versus one or two out of ten from typical fitness YouTubers
Devon faced Levan despite being about 100 lb lighter and 15 years older, instead of dodging dangerous opponents as top draws often do
Defeat teaches far more than victory
Devon pulled Cyplenkov with his weaker arm and kept pulling Levan after partially tearing his biceps
'No limits' does not mean never losing; the man who refuses battle out of fear of defeat is the one who has limits
Mocking a defeated fighter when you have never competed yourself is cowardice
Confidence is the absence of certainty: you convince yourself you will win; refusing anything below a 100% chance of success guarantees failure
Deciding you are doomed is a self-fulfilling prophecy; today's 'reasonable' man is often a coward
The most impressive part of top athletes like Devon is their mind and adaptability, having changed style constantly over 25 years of arm wrestling
After a gym injury, take responsibility and work out what you did wrong instead of declaring the lift evil and never deadlifting again

Devon's 'way of the giant pumpkin' (training one arm only) made that arm grow faster while the other also grew, gaining about an inch; NH would not use it as a bodybuilder because it creates imbalances
Arm wrestlers plan volume, intensity and frequency to the millimetre; you can learn more about bodybuilding from Devon than from many pro bodybuilder channels
Massive bodies are not built by winging it with raw intensity; all top natural bodybuilders on YouTube follow a planned program
Devon follows a rigid schedule, training five to seven times a day
Most people's real enemy is believing they have bad genetics, which imposes limits that do not exist
Drive without direction gets you lost; always have a plan to reach your goals
The best physique belongs not to the man who trains intensely once a week or smart three times a week, but to the one who trains very smart and very intense five times a week
Talk of being a warrior in the gym is mostly empty bravado next to people like Devon who faced real death in combat
Contemplate your own death daily as samurai and Stoics did; it is not nihilism but the realization that limited time makes everything matter
Nihilism is the most abject limitation; believing everything matters opens the field of possibilities
Devon went town to town on foot challenging the strongest arm wrestler in bars, like samurai dojo yaburi; NH is writing a modern warrior manifesto
Find the one thing you love so much you would accept it killing you
exercises: very heavy (~100 kg) partial curls with body english
strap system rigged in a doorway
arm-wrestling specific strength for a single opponent
